name: WebsitePusher
author: WebsitePusher
description: Push your local WordPress changes to your live site safely. Automatic backups before every update, instant undo, and plain English controls built for non developers.
changelog: * Faster full-site pulls: activity and log tables (the Brain Box's queue history, visit logs, form action logs, email logs and the like) bring down only their last 30 days, not years of history. Dashboards and recent counts still work on the local copy.
